verdictOfFindingsScope: source-only; all findings require source reading, no runtime reproduction was performed by this reviewer

findings.title: Committed .orig merge/patch artifacts inside the frozen tree
findings.trigger: Any repository inspection, packaging, or manifest-selection that includes docs/ and component sources; future greps/diffs can pick stale .orig content as if it were current truth.
findings.consequence: Stale duplicate content can be mistaken for canonical source or review evidence; no build/test/runtime impact (Go ignores docs/*.orig; *.orig test files are not compiled; TS *.orig not compiled).
findings.minimalRemedy: Delete the three .orig files in ZCode's next delta (or move to docs/testing/…/retained-if-marked), preserving elsewhere any referenced earlier retained-contract artifact; add *.orig to .gitignore.
findings.acceptedAlternative: If .orig files are intentional evidence by policy, document the policy in the component AGENTS/rule file naming why they ship in-tree.

findings.title: No temporal sanity bounds end-to-end: Go zero-time (year-0001) instants accepted on write, returned by Search, and rendered by the UI
findings.severity: LOW/MEDIUM (data-quality/contract gap; no crash, no security breach observed)
findings.trigger: 1) With an active OWNER/EDITOR session, PATCH/POST an Action, Requirement, Filing cycle due or milestone with dueAt "0001-01-01T00:00:00Z" (any valid RFC3339 instant outside a plausible range is the same class). 2) Search that item (its outcome+) or open work/agenda/detail views.
findings.consequence: Backend parses and persists the year-0001 instant (time.Parse(time.RFC3339) accepts it; TIMESTAMPTZ stores it). Search SQL to_char returns 0001-01-01T00:00:00.000000Z; the store parses it; search_handlers emits it; the frontend resultSchema z.iso.datetime({offset:true}) accepts it; LocalizedInstant renders a year-0001 datetime on the Action card/quick search while any temporal reasoning (timing/lateness weights) treats it as far in the past. Inconsistent with the system-of-operational-truth semantics for legal work; corrupts downstream derived timing displays.
findings.minimalRemedy: Introduce one shared instant-range check (e.g., [1970-01-01, 2500-01-01), configurable) in the backend parse helpers (parseInstant and equivalents in filing/dataops services and dto.ts(tsPtr consumed paths)), returning field validation errors; extend the frontend schemas (search output + work/filing/control input) with the same refinement; add a representative contract/service regression.
findings.evidenceLevel: CONFIRMED_FROM_SOURCE + DEV-1 zod probe (z.iso.datetime({offset:true}) accepts '0001-01-01T00:00:00Z'); no live write attempted
findings.alsoRaisedBySearchPathOnly: search path alone cannot GENERATE zero time in a frozen baseline, since no writer in the frozen tree emits it by default; the gap is reachable only because the write side accepts it.

closedObservations.title: q length/trim semantics
closedObservations.detail: Backend and frontend both enforce 2..100 AFTER trimming q; padding whitespace is banned only around control chars; the zod refine order (control-chars refine before .trim) is fine because neither check is order-sensitive; client already sends query.trim(). No defect.
